        "content": "\"\"\"Record normalization.\n\nUpstream feeds send the same customer record several times, with ids that\niffer only in case or surrounding whitespace. ``normalize_records`` returns\none record per logical id, keeping the most recently updated version.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Dict, Iterable, List\n\n\ndef normalize_id(raw_id: str) -> str:\n    return raw_id.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef normalize_records(records: Iterable[dict]) -> List[dict]:\n    latest: Dict[str, dict] = {}\n    for record in records:\n        key = normalize_id(record[\"id\"])\n        current = latest.get(key)\n        if current is None or record[\"updated_at\"] >= current[\"updated_at\"]:\n            latest[key] = {**record, \"id\": normalize_id(record[\"id\"])}\n    return sorted(latest.values(), key=lambda item: item[\"id\"])",
